description: Production database & REST API container serving the live FiT-UC mobile app.
Node.js authentication microservice exposed securely at udayan.diivvansh.com.
Self-hosted push server handling instant crisis Red Alert notifications for NGO mentors.
Embedded etcd quorum managing cluster scheduling and state across 3 control-plane nodes.
Runs multi-replica NGINX workloads behind MetalLB Layer-2 VIPs and Traefik ingress.
Routes diivvansh.com (pve & udayan subdomains) and fiorejoy.com with zero open firewall ports.
